verdict.rationale: Nitrokey documents a touch-confirmation feature for OpenPGP card operations on Nitrokey 3, plus FIDO2 SSH keys and certificate-based SSH login. These give physical-touch gating of signing, decryption and SSH that an automated process could not complete without a human. The evidence covers only the generic primitives; nothing shows this framed or documented as an approval step for agent-initiated or automated actions. Missing for 10: documentation of using touch as human approval for agent or automated workflows, details of the touch-policy configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
